items.title: Ed Garland Interview, 1958-08-08; 1958-09-03
items.q: I used to be around called a Cuddy all the time... We used to play us in Captains Hall.

ctx.x: You know how kids go. They had to go to church every Sunday night and Sunday, especially Sunday school. And I'd go along with them besides going over to St. Catholic Church. I didn't like to go to church with them, you know. Yeah. The gang. But I used to be around called a Cuddy all the time. That's pretty good view of a party, Cuddy. Sure. That's in Captains. Yeah. That's in me. Right. We used to play us in Captains Hall. Oh yes.
